title: Structural ranking + component metadata for sutra_explore
description:
## Parent

sutra/169 — PRD: sutra_explore

## What to build

Upgrade sutra_explore's ranking from match-density-only to the full weighted formula, and add component metadata to response items.

1. Scoring: match_density × 0.5 + structural_importance (fan_in + blast_radius, normalized) × 0.3 + definition_priority × 0.2. Definitions (fn, struct, trait, impl) score 1.0, references score 0.0.
2. Component annotation: look up each item's component from the component index, add `component` field to response items.
3. Unit tests for the pattern expander (verify literal, snake_case split, and edge cases).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Ranking uses the full 3-signal weighted formula
- [ ] High fan-in definitions rank above low fan-in references for the same query
- [ ] Items carry a `component` field from the component index
- [ ] Pattern expander unit tests cover literal, snake_case split, and empty/single-word queries

## Blocked by

- sutra/171 (review checkpoint 1)
